questions.question: A hole can empty a full tank in 1 hour. To maintain the level of water in the tank, 3 filling pipes of equal efficiency are required. How many more such filling pipes are required so that an empty tank gets filled in 3 hours?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Hole empties = 1 tank/hr ⇒ 3 pipes balance it ⇒ 1 pipe = 1/3 tank/hr

Required net fill rate for 3 hours = 1/3 tank/hr

Let total pipes = n ⇒ net rate = n/3 − 1

n/3 − 1 = 1/3 ⇒ n = 4

**∴ Answer = 1 more pipe**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Hole empties tank in 1 hour, 3 pipes maintain level

**Formula used:**

Work = Efficiency × Time

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let total work = 1 tank

⇒ Emptying rate (hole) = 1 tank/hr

⇒ 3 pipes balance it ⇒ total filling rate = 1 tank/hr

⇒ So, 1 pipe fills = 1/3 tank/hr

⇒ Let required number of pipes = n

⇒ Net filling rate = n × (1/3) − 1

⇒ Tank must be filled in 3 hours ⇒ rate = 1/3 tank/hr

⇒ n/3 − 1 = 1/3

⇒ n/3 = 4/3

⇒ n = 4

⇒ Extra pipes required = 4 − 3 = 1

**∴ The correct answer is 1 more pipe.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Pipes & Cisterns Concept

Filling is positive work and emptying is negative work

Efficiency

Efficiency = Work done per unit time

Balancing Condition

If level remains same ⇒ filling rate = emptying rate

Net Work

Net rate = Filling rate − Emptying rate

questions.question: A shopkeeper buys a toy for ₹200 and sells it for ₹280. What is his profit percentage?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of Cost Price (CP) to Selling Price (SP) = 200 : 280 = 5 : 7

Profit = 7 − 5 = 2 units

Profit % = (2 ÷ 5) × 100 = 40%

**∴ The correct answer is 40%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Cost Price (CP) = ₹200

Selling Price (SP) = ₹280

**Formula Used:**

Profit = SP − CP

Profit % = (Profit ÷ CP) × 100

 CP: ₹200 SP: ₹280 
 
 + ₹80 (Profit) Profit = 40% 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Profit = 280 − 200 = ₹80

⇒ Profit % = (80 ÷ 200) × 100

⇒ Profit % = 0.4 × 100

⇒ Profit % = 40%

**∴ The correct answer is 40%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Loss Percentage

When Cost Price is greater than Selling Price, a loss is incurred. Formula: Loss % = (Loss ÷ CP) × 100.

Marked Price and Discount

Discount is always calculated on the Marked Price (MP) of an article. Formula: SP = MP − Discount.

Successive Discounts

If two successive discounts of a% and b% are given, the single equivalent discount % is given by [a + b − (a × b) ÷ 100]%.

questions.question: Simplify (64x² - 49)/(8x - 7) - 8x .
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Use identity: 64x² − 49 = (8x − 7)(8x + 7)

Cancel (8x − 7) ⇒ expression becomes 8x + 7 − 8x

Remaining term = 7

No need to expand fully

**∴ Answer = 7**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

(64x² − 49) ÷ (8x − 7) − 8x

**Concept Used:**

Algebraic identity and simplification

**Calculation:**

⇒ (64x² − 49) ÷ (8x − 7) − 8x

⇒ [(8x − 7)(8x + 7)] ÷ (8x − 7) − 8x

⇒ (8x + 7) − 8x

⇒ 7

**∴ The correct answer is 7.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Difference of Squares

a² − b² = (a − b)(a + b)

Factorization

Break expressions into factors to simplify fractions

Cancellation Rule

Common factors in numerator and denominator can be cancelled

Quick Trick

Always check for identities before expanding expressions

questions.question: Which of the following ratios is equivalent to 5 : 3?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

An equivalent ratio is obtained by multiplying or dividing both parts by the same non-zero number.

By checking the given options, we can see that multiplying both terms of the ratio 5 : 3 by 10 yields exactly 50 : 30.

**∴ The correct answer is 50 : 30.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Base ratio = 5 : 3

**Method Used:**

Two ratios are equivalent if their simplest forms are identical. We can find the simplest form of each option by dividing both antecedent and consequent by their Highest Common Factor (HCF).

 
 
 Equivalent Ratios 5 parts 3 parts × 10 
 
 50 30 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let us simplify each of the given options to check for equivalence.

⇒ Option 1: 50 : 30 = (50 ÷ 10) : (30 ÷ 10) = 5 : 3

⇒ Option 2: 48 : 33 = (48 ÷ 3) : (33 ÷ 3) = 16 : 11

⇒ Option 3: 53 : 31 is already in its simplest form as 53 and 31 are co-prime.

⇒ Option 4: 125 : 85 = (125 ÷ 5) : (85 ÷ 5) = 25 : 17

⇒ Comparing the simplified forms, only Option 1 correctly matches the base ratio.

**∴ The correct answer is 50 : 30.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Equivalent Ratio

Multiplying or dividing both antecedent (first term) and consequent (second term) of a ratio by the same non-zero number produces an equivalent ratio (e.g., a : b = ma : mb).

Simplest Form

A ratio is said to be in its simplest form if its two terms have no common factor other than 1 (i.e., they are co-prime).

Proportion

When two ratios are equivalent, they form a proportion. For a : b = c : d, the product of extremes equals the product of means (ad = bc).

questions.question: If cosec A = (5)/(4) , then the value of sin 2A + 2cos 2A is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

cosec A = 5/4 ⇒ sin A = 4/5 ⇒ cos A = 3/5

Use identities: sin2A = 2sinAcosA, cos2A = cos²A − sin²A

sin2A = 2×4/5×3/5 = 24/25

cos2A = 9/25 − 16/25 = −7/25

**∴ Answer = 2/25**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

cosec A = 5/4

**Formula used:**

sin A = 1/cosec A, sin2A = 2sinAcosA, cos2A = cos²A − sin²A

**Calculation:**

⇒ sin A = 4/5

⇒ cos A = √(1 − sin²A)

⇒ = √(1 − 16/25) = √(9/25) = 3/5

⇒ sin2A = 2 × 4/5 × 3/5 = 24/25

⇒ cos2A = (3/5)² − (4/5)²

⇒ = 9/25 − 16/25 = −7/25

⇒ sin2A + 2cos2A = 24/25 + 2(−7/25)

⇒ = 24/25 − 14/25

⇒ = 10/25 = 2/5

**∴ The correct answer is 2/5.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Reciprocal Identities

cosec A = 1/sin A

Double Angle Formula

sin2A = 2sinAcosA, cos2A = cos²A − sin²A

Pythagorean Identity

sin²A + cos²A = 1

Shortcut Tip

Use right triangle values for quick calculation

questions.question: P is any point inside the rectangle ABCD. If PA = 87 cm, PB = 12 cm and PC = 96 cm, then the length of PD (in cm) is equal to:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For any point P inside a rectangle ABCD, the sum of the squares of distances to opposite vertices is equal.

PA² + PC² = PB² + PD²

87² + 96² = 12² + PD²

7569 + 9216 = 144 + PD² ⇒ 16785 = 144 + PD²

PD² = 16785 − 144 = 16641 ⇒ PD = √16641 = 129 cm.

**∴ The correct answer is 129 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 
• 
• 
• 
• P A B C D 87 12 96 PD = ? 

**Given:**

PA = 87 cm

PB = 12 cm

PC = 96 cm

**Formula Used:**

According to the **British Flag Theorem**, if P is any point inside a rectangle ABCD, then the sum of the squares of distances from P to opposite vertices is equal. Therefore:

PA² + PC² = PB² + PD²

**Calculations:**

⇒ 87² + 96² = 12² + PD²

⇒ 7569 + 9216 = 144 + PD²

⇒ 16785 = 144 + PD²

⇒ PD² = 16785 − 144

⇒ PD² = 16641

⇒ PD = √16641

⇒ PD = 129 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 129 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

British Flag Theorem

This geometric theorem states that for any point P chosen on the plane of a rectangle ABCD (whether inside or outside the boundaries), the relation PA² + PC² = PB² + PD² always remains completely valid.

Proof by Pythagoras Theorem

This property can be logically proven by drawing perpendiculars from point P to all four sides of the rectangle. This process forms four smaller right-angled triangles, enabling the direct application of the Pythagoras theorem: a² + b² = c² on opposite segments to yield the result.

General Rectangle Properties

In any standard rectangle, opposite sides are necessarily equal and parallel. Additionally, the diagonals are perfectly equal in total length and bisect each other, intersecting securely at the absolute center point.

questions.question: One pipe can fill a tank in 8 minutes, while another pipe can empty the completely filled tank in 16 minutes. If both the pipes are opened together when the tank is empty, how many minutes will it take to fill one-half of the tank?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Filling rate = 1/8, Emptying rate = 1/16

Net rate = 1/8 − 1/16 = 1/16

Time for full tank = 16 minutes

Time for half tank = 16 ÷ 2

**∴ Answer = 8 minutes**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Filling pipe fills tank in 8 minutes, emptying pipe empties tank in 16 minutes

**Formula used:**

Net work = Filling rate − Emptying rate

**Calculation:**

⇒ Filling rate = 1/8 tank per minute

⇒ Emptying rate = 1/16 tank per minute

⇒ Net rate = 1/8 − 1/16

⇒ = 2/16 − 1/16 = 1/16 tank per minute

⇒ Time to fill full tank = 1 ÷ (1/16) = 16 minutes

⇒ Time to fill half tank = 16 ÷ 2 = 8 minutes

**∴ The correct answer is 8 minutes.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Pipes & Cisterns Concept

Filling is positive work and emptying is negative work

Net Rate

Net rate = Sum of individual rates (consider signs)

Time Formula

Time = Work ÷ Rate

Shortcut Insight

If net rate is constant, half work takes half time

questions.question:
The radius of a road roller is 1 { m} , and its length is (21)/(22) { m} . When it is rolled on the ground, it takes 600 rolls to level the entire ground. However, it was found that on 10% of the ground, the roller rolled twice. What is the total area (in sq. m) of the ground?

(Use pi = (22)/(7) , and round off your answer to two decimal places)
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Area per roll = 2πr × l = 2 × 22/7 × 1 × 21/22 = 6 m²

Let total area = A

Effective rolls = 600 but 10% area rolled twice ⇒ extra = 0.1A

Total work = A + 0.1A = 1.1A = 600 × 6

**∴ Answer = 3272.73 m²**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Radius = 1 m, Length = 21/22 m, Rolls = 600, 10% area rolled twice

**Formula used:**

Area covered in one roll = Curved surface area = 2πr × l

**Calculation:**

⇒ Area per roll = 2 × (22/7) × 1 × (21/22)

⇒ = 2 × 3 = 6 m²

⇒ Total area covered by 600 rolls = 600 × 6 = 3600 m²

⇒ Let actual ground area = A

⇒ 10% area rolled twice ⇒ extra coverage = 0.1A

⇒ Total effective coverage = A + 0.1A = 1.1A

⇒ 1.1A = 3600

⇒ A = 3600 ÷ 1.1

⇒ A = 3272.73 m²

**∴ The correct answer is 3272.73 m².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Curved Surface Area of Cylinder

CSA = 2πr × h

Rolling Concept

Area covered per roll equals curved surface area

Double Coverage Concept

If some area is rolled twice, it adds extra coverage

Percentage Conversion

10% = 0.1 in decimal form

questions.question: The cost price of a box of marker is ₹3,300. The shopkeeper gives 75% of discount on the cost price. What will be the selling price (in ₹)?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Discount = 75% ⇒ Selling price = 25% of cost price

25% of 3300 = 3300 ÷ 4

= 825

No need for long calculation

**∴ Answer = 825**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Cost price = 3300, Discount = 75%

**Formula used:**

Selling Price = Cost Price − Discount

**Calculation:**

⇒ Discount = 75% of 3300

⇒ = (75 ÷ 100) × 3300

⇒ = 2475

⇒ Selling Price = 3300 − 2475

⇒ = 825

**∴ The correct answer is 825.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Discount Formula

Discount = (Discount% × Cost Price) ÷ 100

Selling Price

SP = CP − Discount

Shortcut Concept

If discount = x%, then SP = (100 − x)% of CP

Fraction Conversion

25% = 1/4, so divide by 4 directly

questions.question: ₹3,596 is to be divided among three persons M, N and T. If the shares of M and N are in the ratio 6 : 8 and that of N and T are in the ratio 9 : 6, what is the share (in ₹) of N?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Given: M:N = 6:8 and N:T = 9:6

Equalize N ⇒ LCM of 8 and 9 = 72

M:N = 54:72 and N:T = 72:48

Total ratio = 54 + 72 + 48 = 174

**∴ Answer = 1488**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total amount = 3596, M:N = 6:8, N:T = 9:6

**Formula used:**

Equalizing common ratio and proportional division

**Calculation:**

⇒ M:N = 6:8

⇒ N:T = 9:6

⇒ Make N equal ⇒ LCM of 8 and 9 = 72

⇒ Multiply first ratio by 9 ⇒ M:N = 54:72

⇒ Multiply second ratio by 8 ⇒ N:T = 72:48

⇒ Combined ratio = M:N:T = 54:72:48

⇒ Total parts = 54 + 72 + 48 = 174

⇒ Share of N = (72 ÷ 174) × 3596

⇒ = (12 ÷ 29) × 3596

⇒ = 12 × 124

⇒ = 1488

**∴ The correct answer is 1488.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Ratio Equalization

To combine ratios, make the common term equal using LCM

Proportional Division

Share = (Individual ratio ÷ Total ratio) × Total amount

Simplification Trick

Reduce fractions before multiplication

LCM Concept

LCM helps in aligning ratios for easy comparison

questions.question: The price of fuel decreases by 35%, 60% and 10% in three successive months but increases by 65% in the fourth month. What is the percentage increase/decrease in the price of fuel in the fourth month as compared to its original price?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Net factor = 0.65 × 0.40 × 0.90 × 1.65

= 0.234 × 1.65

= 0.3861

Change = 0.3861 − 1 = −0.6139

**∴ Answer = 61.39% decrease**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Successive changes: −35%, −60%, −10%, +65%

**Formula used:**

Net effect = Product of successive multipliers

**Calculation:**

⇒ After 1st month: multiply by (1 − 35/100) = 0.65

⇒ After 2nd month: multiply by (1 − 60/100) = 0.40

⇒ After 3rd month: multiply by (1 − 10/100) = 0.90

⇒ After 4th month: multiply by (1 + 65/100) = 1.65

⇒ Net multiplier = 0.65 × 0.40 × 0.90 × 1.65

⇒ = 0.234 × 1.65

⇒ = 0.3861

⇒ Final price = 0.3861 of original

⇒ Percentage change = (0.3861 − 1) × 100

⇒ = −61.39%

**∴ The correct answer is 61.39% decrease.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Percentage Change

Net effect = (1 + a/100)(1 + b/100)(1 + c/100)...

Decrease Conversion

Decrease of x% ⇒ multiply by (1 − x/100)

Increase Conversion

Increase of x% ⇒ multiply by (1 + x/100)

Final Change Formula

% change = (Final − Original) ÷ Original × 100

questions.question: The arithmetic mean of the observations 35, 26, 56, 41, 56, 46, 34, 16 and 68 is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the assumed mean be 40.

Deviations from 40: −5, −14, +16, +1, +16, +6, −6, −24, +28

Sum of deviations = (−5 − 14 − 6 − 24) + (16 + 1 + 16 + 6 + 28) = −49 + 67 = +18

Average deviation = +18 ÷ 9 = +2

Actual Mean = Assumed Mean + Average deviation = 40 + 2 = 42

**∴ The correct answer is 42.**

Observations: 35, 26, 56, 41, 56, 46, 34, 16, 68

Number of observations (n) = 9

**Formula Used:**

questions.question: Two trains, 163 m and 117 m long, are moving in the same direction at speeds of 93 km/hr and 33 km/hr, respectively. How much time will the faster train take to completely cross the slower one?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Relative speed = 93 − 33 = 60 km/hr = 60 × 5/18 = 16.67 m/s

Total distance = 163 + 117 = 280 m

Time = Distance ÷ Speed = 280 ÷ 16.67

= 16.8 seconds

**∴ Answer = 16.8 seconds**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Lengths = 163 m and 117 m, Speeds = 93 km/hr and 33 km/hr

**Formula used:**

Time = Total distance ÷ Relative speed

**Calculation:**

⇒ Relative speed (same direction) = 93 − 33 = 60 km/hr

⇒ Convert into m/s: 60 × 5/18 = 16.67 m/s

⇒ Total distance = 163 + 117 = 280 m

⇒ Time = 280 ÷ 16.67

⇒ ≈ 16.8 seconds

**∴ The correct answer is 16.8 seconds.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Relative Speed

Same direction ⇒ Relative speed = Difference of speeds

Train Crossing Concept

Total distance = Sum of lengths of both trains

Unit Conversion

km/hr to m/s = × 5/18

Time Formula

Time = Distance ÷ Speed

questions.question: A dealer marks his goods at 50% above the cost price and allows a discount of 52% on the marked price. What is his loss percentage?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let CP = 100 ⇒ MP = 150

Discount = 52% ⇒ SP = 48% of 150

= 72

Loss = 100 − 72 = 28

**∴ Answer = 28% loss**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Marked price = 50% above CP, Discount = 52%

**Formula used:**

MP = CP × (1 + Markup%)

SP = MP × (1 − Discount%)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let CP = 100

⇒ MP = 100 × 1.5 = 150

⇒ SP = 150 × (1 − 52/100)

⇒ = 150 × 0.48 = 72

⇒ Loss = 100 − 72 = 28

⇒ Loss% = (28 ÷ 100) × 100 = 28%

**∴ The correct answer is 28% loss.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Marked Price Concept

MP = CP × (1 + Markup%)

Discount Formula

SP = MP × (1 − Discount%)

Loss Formula

Loss% = (Loss ÷ CP) × 100

Shortcut Tip

Assume CP = 100 for quick calculations

questions.question: A solid wooden cuboid of dimensions 60 cm × 45 cm × 30 cm is cut completely into smaller cubes of side 5 cm each. Find the number of smaller cubes formed.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Number of cubes = (60 ÷ 5) × (45 ÷ 5) × (30 ÷ 5)

= 12 × 9 × 6

= 108 × 6

= 648

**∴ Answer = 648**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Dimensions of cuboid = 60 cm, 45 cm, 30 cm; Side of cube = 5 cm

**Formula used:**

Number of cubes = (Length ÷ side) × (Breadth ÷ side) × (Height ÷ side)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Along length = 60 ÷ 5 = 12

⇒ Along breadth = 45 ÷ 5 = 9

⇒ Along height = 30 ÷ 5 = 6

⇒ Total cubes = 12 × 9 × 6

⇒ = 648

**∴ The correct answer is 648.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Volume Relation

Number of cubes = Volume of cuboid ÷ Volume of one cube

Dimension Division

Divide each dimension by cube side to get count along each axis

Alternative Formula

(l × b × h) ÷ a³

Concept Use

Used in cutting blocks into equal smaller cubes

questions.question: 2 pens and 3 pencils cost ₹35, and 3 pens and 2 pencils cost ₹40. Find the cost of 3 pencils.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Add both equations: (2 pens + 3 pencils) + (3 pens + 2 pencils)

= 5 pens + 5 pencils = 75

⇒ pen + pencil = 15

From first: 2p + 3c = 35 ⇒ substitute p = 15 − c

**∴ Answer = 15**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

2 pens + 3 pencils = 35, 3 pens + 2 pencils = 40

**Formula used:**

Solving linear equations

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let cost of pen = x, pencil = y

⇒ 2x + 3y = 35 ...(1)

⇒ 3x + 2y = 40 ...(2)

⇒ Multiply (1) by 3 ⇒ 6x + 9y = 105

⇒ Multiply (2) by 2 ⇒ 6x + 4y = 80

⇒ Subtract ⇒ (6x + 9y) − (6x + 4y) = 105 − 80

⇒ 5y = 25

⇒ y = 5

⇒ Cost of 3 pencils = 3 × 5 = 15

**∴ The correct answer is 15.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Linear Equations

Two equations can be solved using substitution or elimination

Elimination Method

Make coefficients equal and subtract equations

Shortcut Insight

Add equations to reduce variables quickly

Substitution Method

Express one variable and substitute into another equation

questions.question: A set of data is given, the mean of the set is 40 while the median is set as 70. Find the mode of the data.

Use empirical relation: Mode = 3Median − 2Mean

= 3 × 70 − 2 × 40

= 210 − 80

= 130

**Given:**

Mean = 40, Median = 70

Mode = 3 × Median − 2 × Mean

⇒ = 210 − 80

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Empirical Relation

Mode = 3Median − 2Mean (for moderately skewed data)

Mean

Average value of data set

Median

Middle value when data is arranged

Formula works for unimodal distributions

questions.question: If 20% of a number is added to 96, then the result is the same number. 80% of the same number is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let number = x

20% of x + 96 = x ⇒ 0.2x + 96 = x

⇒ 0.8x = 96 ⇒ x = 120

80% of x = 0.8 × 120

**∴ Answer = 96**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

20% of a number added to 96 equals the number

**Formula used:**

Percentage = (Part ÷ Whole) × 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let number = x

⇒ 20% of x = (20/100) × x = 0.2x

⇒ According to question:

⇒ 0.2x + 96 = x

⇒ x − 0.2x = 96

⇒ 0.8x = 96

⇒ x = 96 ÷ 0.8 = 120

⇒ 80% of x = 0.8 × 120

⇒ = 96

**∴ The correct answer is 96.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Percentage Conversion

x% = x/100

Equation Formation

Translate word problems into algebraic equations

Shortcut Insight

If 20% + 96 = 100%, then 80% = 96

Direct Logic

Remaining percentage gives direct value

questions.question: Zubeda’s income is ₹1,20,000. She spends 20% on accommodation, 35% on household expenses, and 25% on other activities. She saves the remaining amount. What are her total savings?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total expenses = 20% + 35% + 25% = 80%

Remaining = 20% (savings)

Savings = 20% of 120000

= 120000 × 20 ÷ 100 = 24000

**∴ Answer = 24000**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Income = 120000, Expenses = 20%, 35%, 25%

**Formula used:**

Savings = Income − Total expenses

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total expense % = 20 + 35 + 25 = 80%

⇒ Expense amount = 80% of 120000

⇒ = (80 ÷ 100) × 120000 = 96000

⇒ Savings = 120000 − 96000

⇒ = 24000

**∴ The correct answer is 24000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Percentage Sum Rule

Total percentage = 100%, remaining = savings

Savings Formula

Savings = Income × Remaining%

Expense Calculation

Expenses = Sum of all percentage expenditures

Quick Tip

Find leftover percentage directly instead of subtracting amounts

questions.question: A byke travels 80 km at the speed of 40 km/hr and the next 30 km at the speed of 10 km/hr. What is its average speed (in km/hr)?
questions.solution:
` [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total distance = 80 + 30 = 110 km

Time = 80/40 + 30/10 = 2 + 3 = 5 hours

Average speed = Total distance ÷ Total time

= 110 ÷ 5

**∴ Answer = 22 km/hr**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Distance 1 = 80 km, Speed 1 = 40 km/hr; Distance 2 = 30 km, Speed 2 = 10 km/hr

**Formula used:**

Average speed = Total distance ÷ Total time

**Calculation:**

⇒ Time for first part = 80 ÷ 40 = 2 hours

⇒ Time for second part = 30 ÷ 10 = 3 hours

⇒ Total time = 2 + 3 = 5 hours

⇒ Total distance = 80 + 30 = 110 km

⇒ Average speed = 110 ÷ 5

⇒ = 22 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is 22 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Speed Formula

Average speed = Total distance ÷ Total time

Important Note

Do not take simple average of speeds unless time is equal

Time Calculation

Time = Distance ÷ Speed

Shortcut Insight

Always convert into time first, then apply formula

questions.question: Two banks, A and B, offered loans at 3.5% and 7.5% per annum, respectively. Nirmal borrowed an amount of ₹2,40,000 from each bank. Find the positive difference (in ₹) between the amounts of simple interest paid to the two banks by Nirmal after 2 years.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Difference in rates = 7.5% − 3.5% = 4%

SI difference = P × R × T ÷ 100

= 240000 × 4 × 2 ÷ 100

= 240000 × 8 ÷ 100 = 19200

**∴ Answer = 19200**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Principal = 240000, Rates = 3.5% and 7.5%, Time = 2 years

**Formula used:**

Simple Interest = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ SI at 3.5% = (240000 × 3.5 × 2) ÷ 100

⇒ = 240000 × 7 ÷ 100 = 16800

⇒ SI at 7.5% = (240000 × 7.5 × 2) ÷ 100

⇒ = 240000 × 15 ÷ 100 = 36000

⇒ Difference = 36000 − 16800

⇒ = 19200

**∴ The correct answer is 19200.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Simple Interest Formula

SI = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

Shortcut Concept

Difference in SI = P × (R₂ − R₁) × T ÷ 100

Rate Difference

Always subtract smaller rate from larger rate

Time Factor

Interest increases linearly with time in SI

questions.question: The simplified value of the expression [(18 + 6) div 3 times 2 - 4] times [5 + 3²] - 2 times (8 - 3) is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Solve brackets first: (18 + 6) = 24 and (8 − 3) = 5

Expression becomes: [24 ÷ 3 × 2 − 4] × [5 + 9] − 2 × 5

= [8 × 2 − 4] × 14 − 10

= [16 − 4] × 14 − 10 = 12 × 14 − 10

**∴ Answer = 158**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

[(18 + 6) ÷ 3 × 2 − 4] × [5 + 3²] − 2 × (8 − 3)

**Concept Used:**

BODMAS rule

**Calculation:**

⇒ [(18 + 6) ÷ 3 × 2 − 4] × [5 + 3²] − 2 × (8 − 3)

⇒ [24 ÷ 3 × 2 − 4] × [5 + 3²] − 2 × (8 − 3)

⇒ [24 ÷ 3 × 2 − 4] × [5 + 9] − 2 × (8 − 3)

⇒ [8 × 2 − 4] × 14 − 2 × (8 − 3)

⇒ [16 − 4] × 14 − 2 × 5

⇒ 12 × 14 − 2 × 5

⇒ 168 − 2 × 5

⇒ 168 − 10

⇒ 158

**∴ The correct answer is 158.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

BODMAS Full Form

Brackets, Orders, Division, Multiplication, Addition, Subtraction

Order of Operations

Solve brackets first, then powers, then ÷ and ×, then + and −

Left to Right Rule

For × and ÷, solve from left to right

Simplification Tip

Always simplify step-by-step without skipping operations

questions.question: The mother of two sons is 20 years older than her elder son. Five years from now, the elder son will be twice as old as the younger son, and the ratio of their current ages is 3 : 1. What is the current age (in years) of the mother?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio (elder : younger) = 3 : 1 ⇒ let ages = 3x and x

After 5 yrs: 3x + 5 = 2(x + 5)

⇒ 3x + 5 = 2x + 10 ⇒ x = 5

Elder = 15 ⇒ Mother = 15 + 20 = 35

**∴ Answer = 35 years**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Mother is 20 years older than elder son, ratio of sons = 3 : 1

**Formula used:**

Age relation and linear equation

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let present ages of elder and younger be 3x and x

⇒ After 5 years: elder = 3x + 5, younger = x + 5

⇒ Given: elder = 2 × younger

⇒ 3x + 5 = 2(x + 5)

⇒ 3x + 5 = 2x + 10

⇒ 3x − 2x = 10 − 5

⇒ x = 5

⇒ Elder son = 3x = 15

⇒ Mother’s age = 15 + 20 = 35

**∴ The correct answer is 35 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Ratio Method

Assume ages in ratio form to simplify equations

Future Age Concept

Add given years to present ages

Linear Equation

Form equation using condition and solve

Age Difference Rule

Age difference remains constant over time

questions.question: Find the smallest number to be added to 1000 so that 45 divides the sum exactly.1265
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Find remainder of 1000 ÷ 45

45 × 22 = 990 ⇒ remainder = 10

To make it divisible, add (45 − 10)

= 35

**∴ Answer = 35**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Number = 1000, Divisor = 45

**Concept Used:**

Remainder and divisibility

**Calculation:**

⇒ Divide 1000 by 45

⇒ 45 × 22 = 990

⇒ Remainder = 1000 − 990 = 10

⇒ Required number to be added = 45 − 10

⇒ = 35

⇒ New number = 1000 + 35 = 1035

⇒ 1035 ÷ 45 = 23 (exact)

**∴ The correct answer is 35.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Remainder Concept

Remainder = Dividend − (Divisor × Quotient)

Divisibility Rule

To make divisible, subtract remainder from divisor

Shortcut Trick

Required addition = Divisor − Remainder

Verification

Always check by dividing final number
